Coram : R. SUBHASH REDDY*, HRISHIKESH ROY
Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 – Contempt – When not – Land belonging to the petitioner acquired under 1894 Act – s.4 notification issued in 1981, possession taken – Land subsequently declared as protected forest – – Fresh/further notifications issued – Challenged by petitioner in writ petition, various other writ petitions pending – Award passed in 2006 purportedly pursuant to 1981 notification – High Court held that the possession and title of the land vested in the respondent-State
Decision Date : 14-12-2021 | Case No : CONTEMPT PETITION (CIVIL) No. 726/2017 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
